title: THE FOUR OLDS audio play — a02_bank

lines.sfx: A fluorescent tube ticks and hums over the loan desk.
A loan officer talks into a phone wedged against his shoulder while a keyboard clicks under his hands.

lines.text: (off the phone) Grab a seat, I'll be right with you.
(then, into the phone) No, that's the county's. The culvert out on the section line, that's not us. Tell him to call Roads.
(then) Yeah. The number's on their website somewhere. Alright. Bye.

lines.sfx: The phone drops back into its cradle.
A chair creaks as Cricket lowers into it and a thick folder settles on his knees.
A draft off the street door rattles a cardboard sign propped in the window.
The folder falls open and pages riffle down under his thumb.
A single sheet slides onto the desk between them.

lines.text: They reassessed the home place. I came about the sixty days.

lines.sfx: The keyboard picks up as he enters the account.

lines.text: Forty-two oh six, due the fifteenth. Okay.
(then) And you're sitting at, what, twenty-one hundred in the checking.
Twenty-one forty. As of the tenth.
Right.

lines.sfx: A mouse clicks and the typing slows while he reads the next screen under his breath.

lines.text: There's a hardship program. There was. Let me just...
(then) It's paused. Not paused — there's no — there isn't a mechanism right now. Is what that means.
Who do I talk to, then.
That's the thing. It went federal in the spring. There's no office to send you to anymore, it just says pending review.

lines.sfx: The scroll wheel ratchets down the account history and stops.

lines.text: That's — hang on. You've got a payroll line on here.

lines.sfx: The typing stops.

lines.text: (reading) NASA. Payroll. Zero dollars, quarterly, going back to seventy-two.
(then) And it's got you down here as astronaut. Active. I've never seen the system do that.
(then) I can scrub it for you while we're in here. It's just sitting there wrong anyway.
(quick) Leave it.

lines.sfx: The mouse goes quiet.

lines.text: It's been there fifty years. It can stay.

lines.sfx: The cursor clicks away from the line.

lines.text: Okay.

lines.sfx: A drawer rolls open and something wooden knocks around inside it.

lines.text: Our scanner's been down since Tuesday. So if your paperwork came in today and I couldn't scan it, it wouldn't post until next cycle.

lines.sfx: The stamp comes down twice on the form, two flat thunks, and the page turns on the desk.

lines.text: That buys you about sixty days. Don't tell my branch manager.

lines.sfx: He peels the yellow carbon off the back and slides it across the desk.

lines.text: What do I owe you.
It's a bank, Mr. Dawes. You owe us four thousand dollars.

lines.sfx: The folder claps shut and the chair pushes back, and his boots cross to the door.
The boots stop.

lines.text: That culvert. On the section line.
...Yeah?
Route 12, out by the Hollen place. Log chain and a tractor'll do it. Hour of work.

lines.sfx: The door pulls open and swings shut behind him.

lines.text: ...I'll pass that on. Every quarter, huh.

lines.sfx: The chair rolls back to the desk and the keyboard starts up again.
Out on the street the bank door thumps shut and a truck door opens and closes.
Across the street a flag halyard taps against the courthouse pole.
In the quiet cab he lets out one long breath.

lines.text: "Working for communities like yours."

lines.sfx: He turns the key and the engine catches.
